name: TT Club Experience: TT live, with 2 Fellas and Limapump
description: TT, the singer behind "Dança este som", "Deixa-te levar", "Faz acontecer" and "Vem cá", plays a concert at Maria Pistolas, followed by DJ sets from 2 Fellas and Limapump.
longDescription:
TT Club Experience brings TT to Maria Pistolas for a live set of hits including "Dança este som", "Deixa-te levar", "Faz acontecer" and "Vem cá". 2 Fellas and Limapump follow with DJ sets.

The night runs on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 23:59 until 06:00. Tickets cost €15 without a drink, or €20 with one drink included.

Maria Pistolas is on Praça de Dona Filipa de Lencastre, Porto.
